lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: Hey, guys!

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: I heard there's a new shopping mall opening up on Royal Road.

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: Want to go check it out sometime?

lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: Did you say shopping mall?

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: Uh-huh!

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: If the Commander's going, then count me in.
I'm good.

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: Stood up again?!

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: Come on, I'm inviting you to come with me. Pleeeaaase?

lines.speaker: yulha
lines.text: I'm busy, you two go without me.

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: Hmph.

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: I just saw you finishing up all the paperwork.

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: You just want to go off on your own and get drunk.

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: What's with you guys? Don't you wanna have fun?

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: What's wrong with going shopping every once in a while?

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: More importantly,

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: this could be

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: a team-building exercise!

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: So when you think about it, we actually HAVE to go.

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: Don't you think we've been lacking a sense of unity?

lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: I don't buy this team-building baloney for a second.

lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: You just want to go shopping.

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: Not at all!

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: I mean... I would like to go shopping...

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: but that's not all I'm after!
Liar.

lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: Liar.

lines.speaker: yulha
lines.text: Enough. If you wanna go, go by yourself.

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: ... But what about all that stuff I said about team building?

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: Why don't you believe me?

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: It's been ages since we all last hung out.

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: That's why I suggested this whole shopping idea in the first place.

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: You're all putting words in my mouth.

lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: In that case, I'll go with you.

lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: I don't like crowded places,

lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: but I'll go as long as Yulha and the Commander come too.

lines.speaker: yulha
lines.text: Fine, I'll go.

lines.speaker: yulha
lines.text: Newbie, when can we expect you?
Do I have to?

lines.speaker: yulha
lines.text: This is a team-building exercise.

lines.speaker: yulha
lines.text: What do you think?

lines.speaker: yulha
lines.text: Everyone has to attend, and you're no exception.

lines.speaker: yulha
lines.text: If you don't want to participate, perhaps you should leave our group chat.
Guess I don't have much of a choice...

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: What time should we head out?

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: Now?

lines.speaker: yulha
lines.text: What's the hurry?

lines.speaker: yulha
lines.text: Let me finish reading this report first.

lines.speaker: yulha
lines.text: When I'm done, I'll let you know.

lines.speaker: yulha
lines.text: I'll talk to you later, Newbie.

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: Later, Commander.

lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: See ya soon, Commander!
See you.
